text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Guh...!! *pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: (Go...! Move, my legs...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...You can do it! Do your beeeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... Yaaaaaaaah!! Reaaaaaaaach!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—It's Vivlos! It's Vivlos! The winner of 
the Shuka Sho is Vivlos! With this...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Triple Crown achieved!! Inheriting the 
hopes of her older sister Verxina, Vilbros 
has become a Triple Tiara Umamusume...!
(Uwoooooah!!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Me... a Triple Tiara Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis... Big sis! I won...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Incredible... Vivlos. You truly are...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: "Vivlos.........! Nggghhhhh~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: Papaaa, *sniff*, don't cryyy, waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Father & Mother
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAHH! WAHHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The photo finish result is in! First 
place goes to number 14! Number 14! After 
a long, agonizing photo finish... the 
victor is Gentildonna!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And with this, the fourth Triple Tiara 
Umamusume in history is born!!
(Waaaaaah...!)
(Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —...That's amazing, Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because she's my little sister—precisely 
why—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Big sis?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...Um, are you okay?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I'm fine. I just got a little 
overwhelmed with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I must offer her my congratulations. Well 
done, Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Thank you—

Having brilliantly avenged Verxina and 
become a Triple Tiara Umamusume, Vivlos 
was in high spirits. And for her—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~, what a party! Sooo high-class 
celebrity!!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, right? It's a present from us! 
Enjoy it to your heart's content!
choice_data_list:
(W-Wow, this is on a whole other 
scale...!)

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please make sure you enjoy 
yourself too. The food at this hotel is 
absolutely delicious!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, you prepared something this 
incredible for me!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"What were you planning to do if I didn't 
win?"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's changed! No matter what place 
you finished in, it doesn't change the 
fact that you gave it your all on the 
Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Our pride in you... in everyone... that 
feeling will never ever change!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Congratulations again, Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis / Big brother! Ehehe, are you 
happy?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, very much!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Nihehe♪ That's the exact look I wanted 
to see!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Mommy's smiling too~. 
Tee-hee♪

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: Papa, you too! Grrriiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer, you too!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: ...*stare*

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not doing it...!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Hahaha...!

“――Ahaha...! Alright, what should we check 
out next!”
"Look, Vivlos! It's so beautiful—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Did it show? Yeah... it's so much fun—

The party ended, and at Vivlos's request, 
we headed back to the academy ahead of the 
others.
choice_data_list:
Are you sure it was okay not to go with 
everyone?

Was it really okay not to be with 
everyone?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because I wanted to talk to you, 
Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I avenged my big sister, fair and square! 
Now I can move forward.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Now I can aim for Dubai with everything 
I've got!

Yes, from here on... we'll be aiming for 
her other dream: racing in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I realized something today. I really, 
truly want to go to Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: What should we start with?

First, I need info on how Vivlos might 
perform in Dubai. To do that, I have to 
pick a domestic race under similar 
conditions.
choice_data_list: I'd like to aim for the "Nakayama Kinen".

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Oh! I was just thinking that too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"There are Umamusume who got great results 
at the Nakayama Kinen and went on to win 
in Dubai, after all."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm the Dubai Master, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"From the Nakayama Kinen to Dubai... It's 
decided!♪"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Go to Dubai, and then...! I'm gonna become 
a super-celeb~~!

And so, aiming for the races in Dubai... 
we first take on the prep race, the 
Nakayama Kinen!
